evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Evaluating on DBLP-QuAD 2.0 showed that its scores depend on the graph snapshot, the endpoint used, and the wording of its machine-generated questions, so we propose DBLP-QuAD 3.1, which maintains the intent of 2.0 while making reference results deterministic, revising reference SPARQL where needed, and rewriting the natural language questions, with a frontier model, to state each reference query's intent clearly and completely.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate on the DBLP-QuAD 2.0 benchmark (57.6% Match under deterministic re-scoring), DBLP-QuAD 3.1 (89.9% Match on 1,000 questions), SemOpenAlex (98% Match against a published baseline's 86% on the identical test set), and neuroimaging metadata (100%).
